subject.title: feat(ui): accept drag-and-drop attachments in the new-session composer

question: Should maintainers accept the Control UI policy that file drops are always cancelled and ingested, while non-file drops remain native only on actual text-entry controls and are cancelled elsewhere?
rationale: The implementation is a targeted extension of an existing attachment workflow, but the protected `maintainer` label requires an explicit maintainer acceptance decision rather than automated cleanup or closure.
